description: Amending the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, has been introduced to make provisions for the registration of titles to land plots, the regularization of transactions relating to such registered land plots and matters incidental thereto. Following the enactment of the said Act, necessary steps have been taken to prepare cadastral maps and register title determinations islandwide since 1998. With the registration of title determinations, the Registrar General's Department has taken steps to establish a data system and steps have been taken to integrate that data system with the Land Information System prepared by the Survey Department. However, various problems have been identified in the implementation of the National Land Registration programme 'Bimsaviya', and the programme has so far failed to achieve the desired goals. Considering that situation, steps have been taken to identify the amendments to be made to the Registration of Title Act with the participation of all relevant sectors. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to amend the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, based on the said amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.
